translation: In the conditions of injury, when there is bleeding from the affected area or from the various orifices, this is because liver fire (肝火) is blazing and the blood, being hot, leaves its channels and runs recklessly; use Modified Free and Easy Powder (加味逍遙散) to clear heat and nourish the blood. If the middle qi (中氣) is weak and deficient, and the blood has nothing to which to attach and runs recklessly, use Modified Four Gentlemen Decoction (加味四君子湯) and Supplementing the Middle and Benefiting Qi Decoction (補中益氣湯). Or if the original qi collapses internally and cannot contain the blood, use Single Ginseng Decoction (獨參湯) with added parched ginger (炮姜) to restore the yang; if there is no response, urgently add aconite (附子).
